newsitem.title: EGYPT: RESEARCH ALERT- Egypt mill recommended.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Egypt mill recommended.

text.p: Egyptian market analysts Prime Investments recommended on Monday that investors buy shares in Upper Egypt Flour Mills at 79 pounds ($23.27).

It said 1996/97 financial year sales of 610 million pounds resulting from the company's increased output of 72 percent extraction flour pushed profits up by 48 percent. Eleven month net profit after tax figures for the financial year ending June 1997 were 49.6 million pounds compared to 33.5 million the previous year.
The 1997 increase of high grade flour production from 54,000 tonnes to 217,000 per year is expected to account for over 50 percent of the mill's increased profits, Prime Investments said.
It said UEFM earnings are expected to remain stable until the year 2000 when its expansion project is fully implemented, in which 100,000 tonnes of high-grade flour will be produced annually.
Prime Investments attributed a 30 percent decline in milling sector stocks to investors' forseeing a negative price influence from increased private sector competition.
"It is our view these worries have been overcompensated for by the market and that the sector as a whole is undervalued at current prices," Prime said.
Upper Egypt Flour Mill's prospective 9.7 P/E ratio is compared to an industry average of just under 12.
Prime Investments gave a 1997 dividend forecast of five pounds, which would generate a yield of 6.3 percent at its close of 79 pounds.
